Habitus Taxonym: Koeleria macrantha ss Fischer et al. EfÖLS 2008 ISBN 978-3-85474-187-9 Location: to the Sourth of Ladendorf, district Mistelbach, Lower Austria - ca. 260 m a.s.l. Habitat: dry meadows
Crested hair-grass is characteristic of CG2 grassland
Koeleria growing through a mat of Selaginella densa.
The persistent old and newly produced leaf sheaths and blades are distinctly striate on both surfaces. The ligule is always very short. The hairs are variably present.
The inflorescence or panicle is very spikelike in this area.
